editorial.blurb: Addis serves authentic, freshly made Ethiopian cuisine in an intimate space where warm hospitality and stunningly good food create an unforgettable experience.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask the owners what their famous dish is—they'll guide you well, and arrive with patience since everything is made to order, but the wait is absolutely worth it.

topDishes.note: divine, tender meat perfectly seasoned with creamy cheese and smooth collards
remarkably good, even for non-seafood eaters
